name: The Father
appearance: An older gentleman of grave authority, plainly and correctly dressed, with the immovable bearing of a man used to being obeyed.
definition: A father who rules his household by expectation and duty, weighing prospects and propriety above his children's wishes. His approval is hard-won and his disappointment quietly devastating.
voice: Grave and authoritative, sparing of praise; he speaks in judgments and expects them to settle the matter.
